review.summary: Phoenix is currently in a research-only phase with significant gaps in its architecture and controls. The lack of settled outcomes and verified observations, along with the inability to promote candidates without meeting strict empirical baselines, leads to a rejection of the current implementation.
top_technical_reasons: No verified BCS observations to support claims.
Storage backends are not fully connected, limiting data access.
Fact-check stage is injectable but not yet canonical, raising safety concerns.
The orchestrator is not yet integrated into the Streamlit runtime, affecting functionality.
review.candidate_safety: The current implementation lacks sufficient safety checks and has not undergone rigorous acceptance testing, posing risks to deployment.
